title: Missing docstring with TestRail URL in test method
description: The test method 'test_03_verify_the_position_of_the_buttons_on_the_cancel_shortcut_creation_pop_up_window_C48' is missing its required docstring. According to the differences provided, the complete docstring block containing the description 'Verify the buttons of cancel shortcut creation pop up window.' and TestRail URL 'https://hp-testrail.external.hp.com/index.php?/cases/view/48' was removed and replaced with only an inline comment '# LOCAL MISTAKE: Missing docstring with TestRail URL'. This violates the HPX automation framework's documentation standards where all test methods must have a properly formatted docstring with a description and TestRail URL reference.
recommendation: Add the complete docstring block immediately after the method definition line. The docstring must follow the standard HPX test method format with triple quotes, a descriptive text explaining what the test verifies, and a TestRails reference line with the full URL.
solution:
Add the complete docstring block immediately after the method definition line. The docstring must follow the standard HPX test method format with triple quotes, a descriptive text explaining what the test verifies, and a TestRails reference line with the full URL.

Correct implementation:

def test_03_verify_the_position_of_the_buttons_on_the_cancel_shortcut_creation_pop_up_window_C48(self):
    """
    Verify the buttons of cancel shortcut creation pop up window.
    TestRails -> https://hp-testrail.external.hp.com/index.php?/cases/view/48
    """
    assert self.hpx_shortcuts.verify_add_new_shortcut_screen_title()
    assert self.hpx_shortcuts.verify_cancel_shortcut_go_back_btn()

This correction:
1. Removes the inline comment '# LOCAL MISTAKE: Missing docstring with TestRail URL'
2. Adds the proper triple-quoted docstring immediately after the method signature
3. Includes the descriptive text 'Verify the buttons of cancel shortcut creation pop up window.'
4. Includes the TestRails reference line with the complete URL 'TestRails -> https://hp-testrail.external.hp.com/index.php?/cases/view/48'
5. Closes with triple quotes

This format is consistent with all other test methods (test_01, test_02, test_04, test_05, test_06) in the file and complies with the HPX automation framework's documentation standards. Every test method must have a docstring with a description and TestRail URL for traceability and documentation purposes.

mistake_content: Missing module-level variable 'pytest.app_info = "HPX"' at the top of the test file (after imports, before class definition)
solution:
Add the following line after all imports and before the class definition:

pytest.app_info = "HPX"

This is REQUIRED for all HPX Pattern A tests as per KB Section 5.1. The module-level variable tells the framework which app to install and launch. Without it, the test framework cannot properly identify the application under test.

mistake_content: Incorrect fixture usage: class_setup is using 'android_hpx_flow_setup' fixture which returns both driver and fc, violating Pattern A architecture
solution:
Replace the current class_setup fixture with the correct Pattern A implementation:

@pytest.fixture(scope="class", autouse=True)
def class_setup(cls, windows_test_setup, load_printers_session):
    cls = cls.__class__
    cls.driver = windows_test_setup
    cls.p = load_printers_session
    cls.fc = FlowContainer(cls.driver)
    cls.printer_name = cls.p.get_printer_information()["model name"]

Pattern A REQUIRES:
- FlowContainer is created INSIDE the test class fixture (not from session)
- Uses 'windows_test_setup' fixture (provides driver)
- Uses 'load_printers_session' fixture (provides printer object)
- Creates NEW FlowContainer per class: cls.fc = FlowContainer(cls.driver)
- NO usage of request.session.driver or request.session.fc

This is documented in KB Section 5.1 'PATTERN A: HPX ONLY (PRINTER TESTS)'

mistake_content: Missing FlowContainer import statement required for Pattern A
solution:
Add the following import at the top of the file with other imports:

from MobileApps.libs.flows.windows.hpx_rebranding.flow_container import FlowContainer

This import is REQUIRED because Pattern A creates FlowContainer inside the class_setup fixture. The FlowContainer is the central orchestrator for all HPX automation flows as documented in KB Section 4.

solution: Add the TestRail case ID suffix '_C49' to the test method name. According to Section 7.1 (TEST FILE ANATOMY & CONVENTIONS) and Section 20.1 (NAMING CONVENTIONS) of the HPX QE QAMA Scripting Best Practice Knowledge Base, all test methods MUST follow the naming pattern: 'test_XX_<description>_C<testrail_id>' where 'C<testrail_id>' is the TestRail case ID suffix. The docstring already references 'TestRails -> https://hp-testrail.external.hp.com/index.php?/cases/view/49', confirming this is case C49. The correct method name should be: 'test_04_verify_the_screen_when_the_user_clicks_on_go_back_button_C49'. This suffix is mandatory for traceability between automated tests and TestRail test cases, enabling proper test management and reporting integration.
